add.title: Guernsey Prison - Wikipedia
add.summary: Wikipedia article on Guernsey Prison (Les Nicolles), the island's only prison: opened 1989, 11 wings, capacity 139, operated by the States of Guernsey and accommodating male, female and vulnerable prisoners of juvenile and adult ages (population ~99 in November 2024). Contains no birth-sex-vs-identity housing rule, no trans special unit, and no solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners; verdict thin: no usable finding on the prison-housing axis.
